name: capture-reveal
title: Capture Reveal
description: Screenshot capture animation: a toast counts "Capturing selection…" up to 100% over a browser window, the window drops away and shrinks, the toast pops to "Copied to clipboard." and a two-line headline rises out from behind the window while the cursor glides up. Every curve was measured off a recording frame by frame: the window's drop and shrink share one cubic-bezier, the toast pops on another, the headline rises without scaling or blurring, and type moves by fractions of a pixel.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/screens/capture-reveal?ref=cli — src is the screenshot in the window (laid in at full width, top first); headline breaks lines on |; capturing and copied are the two toast messages. Pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette. — 73 Pro components too — charts, launch scenes, device shots: https://snapcn.dev/docs/pricing?ref=cli-docs
